subject: POC prompt/log harvest runbook + evaluation commitments
messages:
From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@novalogic.ai>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Legal Ops <legal@novalogic.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps — prompt & logs handoff for POC (runbook)

Thanks again for the demo this morning — the team was impressed with the latency and the traceability features. As discussed, we're ready to hand over a sample of our user prompts and the related server-side logs for the 4-week POC. Attaching the initial manifest and a CSV with a 2k-sample of prompt IDs for your eval team to validate.

Quick context: these prompts come from our support and billing flows (no payment data in the samples). We filtered obvious PII but have one question below on masking guidance.

Attachments:
- prompt_sample_list.csv (CSV, ~18KB) — list of prompt_id, source, approximate token_lengths
- logs_manifest.json (JSON, 4KB) — describes log files and schema

What we need from Redwood:
1) A short runbook describing the upload mechanism and required file naming conventions so our SREs can upload securely.
2) An evaluation acceptance checklist — what pass/fail looks like (examples: median latency under X ms on hosted trial, top-1/3 retrieval accuracy for rerank, safety regression threshold).
3) Owners and timeline — who at Redwood will be the primary contact for dataset ingestion and the evaluation lead.

Proposed timeline: sample handoff this week, full bulk transfer (if accepted) next week, POC evaluation completed within 3 weeks after transfer.

Questions for you now:
- Do we need to scrub anything additional on our side (we prefer the minimal manual work)?
- Do you provide a temporary S3 endpoint or do you prefer a direct SFTP drop?

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

--
Ethan Cole
Head of Product, Novalogic
ethan.cole@novalogic.ai
+1 415 555 0187
From: connor_obrien@redwood.ai <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@novalogic.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps — prompt & logs handoff for POC (runbook)

Ethan — thanks for the clear manifest and sample. This looks good and we can accept the dataset as-is with a few guardrails. Below is a short runbook and the eval acceptance checklist we propose — I'm copying Marissa (eval lead) and Hiro (security) so they can confirm operational owners.

Runbook (high level):
- Transfer method: secure pre-signed S3 upload. We will create a scoped bucket and provide single-use presigned POSTs for each file name in the manifest.
- File naming: <company>_<project>_<dataset_type>_<YYYYMMDD>_<part>.ext (example: novalogic_poc_prompts_20260701_part1.csv)
- Required metadata: manifest.json in root with schema_version, uploader_email, sha256 checksums for each file.
- Max single file size: 5GB. For >5GB we'll provide multipart guidance.
- Post-upload: We run an automated ingestion validation (schema + tokenization sanity checks) and will surface a validation report within 6 hours of successful upload.

Evaluation acceptance checklist (initial):
- Data integrity: checksums match and manifest valid.
- Coverage: sample contains minimum 1,500 prompts across support/billing flows or we request additional sampling.
- Performance: median token-level latency under 220ms for our hosted small-provision trial profile (1k token prompt + 128 token gen).
- Quality: no more than 2% safety regressions on your eval prompts vs. the baseline we measure pre-POC.
- Repro: at least one deterministic rerank test with seed/params included.

Owners & timeline: 
- Dataset ingestion owner: connor_obrien (you can reach me directly for any upload issues).
- Eval lead: marissa_cole (will produce the evaluation report and quality checks).
- Security & compliance contact: hiro_tanaka (for any PII questions and KMS handling).
- Sales contact for contract/terms questions: ben_carter.

Proposed milestone dates (can adjust):
- 2026-07-01: Provide presigned upload links and manifest template.
- 2026-07-02 to 2026-07-03: Customer uploads sample & full batch if ready.
- 2026-07-03: Ingestion validation report delivered.
- 2026-07-06: Initial eval report (latency, quality regressions, acceptance recommendation).

PII guidance: if the samples still contain emails or hashed identifiers you prefer not to share, you can either remove them or replace with consistent synthetic tokens (e.g., [USER_123]). We will not request raw payment tokens. Hiro, anything to add?

If that all looks good I will open the upload ticket and send the presigned links.

Thanks,
Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai
From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@novalogic.ai>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, Legal Ops <legal@novalogic.ai>
Date: Fri, 03 Jul 2026 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps — prompt & logs handoff for POC (runbook)

Thanks Connor — that runbook/ checklist is exactly what we need. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We have ~3.6k candidate prompts in the full batch and can easily produce the 1.5k sample you mentioned.
- The logs include session_ids and IPs; we will hash session_ids with sha256 and remove raw IPs (replace with city-level geo tags) before upload. Is that sufficient for your compliance team?
- For the transfer, presigned S3 is perfect. Please share the presigned POSTs and the manifest template.

Legal note: our Legal Ops asked for a short Data Processing Addendum (DPA) for the POC that covers data residency and retention (we propose 30 days post-eval). Samantha (CC) will follow up with a proposed clause.

We aim to start transfer Tuesday (7/6). Let us know if that start date works for your ingestion window.

--
Ethan
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 06 Jul 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps — prompt & logs handoff for POC (runbook)

Ethan — great, thanks for the confirm and for looping Legal. A couple operational notes and the concrete next steps from the eval side below.

> Thanks Connor — that runbook/ checklist is exactly what we need. A few clarifications from our side: 
> 
> - We have ~3.6k candidate prompts in the full batch and can easily produce the 1.5k sample you mentioned.
> - The logs include session_ids and IPs; we will hash session_ids with sha256 and remove raw IPs (replace with city-level geo tags) before upload. Is that sufficient for your compliance team?
> - For the transfer, presigned S3 is perfect. Please share the presigned POSTs and the manifest template.
> 
> Legal note: our Legal Ops asked for a short Data Processing Addendum (DPA) for the POC that covers data residency and retention (we propose 30 days post-eval). Samantha (CC) will follow up with a proposed clause.

Responses / next steps from Redwood eval team:
- Security: hashing session_ids + removing IPs to city-level is fine for the POC. Hiro will provide a short checklist of acceptable hashes and confirm that we will store the data encrypted at rest with access limited to the eval team.
- Retention: 30 days post-eval is acceptable; we'll reflect that in a scoped DPA addendum. Ben will coordinate the commercial note if there are special requirements.
- Ingestion window: Tuesday 2026-07-06 works. Connor will create the presigned POSTs and send the manifest template by EOD 2026-07-01 as proposed.

Eval plan (what we'll deliver after ingestion):
1) Ingestion validation report (schema + tokenization) — same day as upload (within 6 hours).
2) Baseline measurements: latency profile and deterministic rerank reproducibility tests — 48 hours post-ingest.
3) Quality assessment: safety regression check and top-k retrieval accuracy on your provided holdouts — 5 business days post-ingest.
4) Recommendation & acceptance: pass/fail and a short remediation list if anything fails acceptance criteria.

Owners recap:
- Ingestion: connor_obrien
- Eval & quality: marissa_cole
- Security review / DPA: hiro_tanaka
- Commercial / contract: ben_carter

I'll follow up with the Eval intake doc and a short checklist for the manifest (fields, checksum examples) in a separate email. If you want a call Thursday to walk through the manifest template, say 11am PT — Ben will join for contract context.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Applied ML Engineer, Redwood Inference
